editorial:
Imagine you are at the top of your game, crushing it at work in New York City, and suddenly your whole world flips upside down. That is exactly what happens to J.C. Wiatt. She is a high-powered executive who thinks she has everything figured out until a surprise baby lands in her lap. You will love how the movie balances the stress of corporate life with the chaos of diaper changes. It is a lighthearted ride that feels like a cozy hug, showing you the struggle of a woman trying to prove she can handle a career and motherhood at the same time without losing her mind.

Diane Keaton is absolutely great here, bringing a quirky energy that keeps the story moving fast. While some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable, the charm makes up for it. If you want a feel-good story about independence, you should definitely give this a go. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the best way to keep this classic around.
endingExplained: After being pushed out of her firm, J.C. starts her own successful business from home while raising Elizabeth. She proves that she does not need a big boss to be a winner. In the end, she finds a new romantic interest who actually supports her as a mother. She manages to balance her professional success and her love for the baby, showing everyone that you can define success on your own terms.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic 80s comedies and stories about female empowerment.
